events.title: Remote Code Execution in Gitea (CVE-2026-60004)
events.summary: Published: Thu 27 Aug 2026

reasons: reported by an Australian source

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-60004 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-08-25, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-08-28.
CVE-2026-60004 is rated 9.8 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-60004 being exploited in the next 30 days at 24%.
A fix for gitea.dev (Go) is published in 1.27.1, per GHSA-rcr6-4jqh-j84m.
